digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model tracing and instrumentation
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order and provider-qualified model identity, parented to the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, with no duplication from instrument_all.

Candidate outcome must be recorded from the closed vocabulary {returned, raised}, where raised outcomes have their error reasons redacted through sanitize_diagnostic with no prompt, response, credential, or endpoint secret exposed.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup, RunUsage accounting, and S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must remain unchanged; instrumentation is purely observational and best-effort, swallowing span-emission failures to preserve identical results when tracing is disabled.

Concrete candidate models must be wrapped in a WrapperModel subclass inside build_fallback_model without altering fallback predicates, selection order, ProviderSession lifecycle, or _pai_structured control flow.
A span-emission or exporter failure while tracing is enabled must leave the fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off behavior.
The base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error.
